frozen_questions.question: Does the 20-variable primal graph expose articulation points, bridges, or vertex separators of size <=4, and what is its exact minimum vertex cut if <=4?

Does the bipartite variable-constraint incidence graph expose articulation points or bridges, and what low-order variable-only separators of size <=4 disconnect its surviving constraint-variable structure?
What is the distribution of pairwise clause-scope intersections 0/1/2 variables, and is the clause-overlap graph connected under >=1 and >=2 shared variables?
For each variable, how many incident constraints belong to each of the eight frozen relation surfaces and to Horn-admitting versus dual-Horn-admitting local classes?

How many distinct source-bound variable signatures occur using degree, positive/negative occurrence counts, relation-surface incidence counts, and primal-neighbor degree multiset; do any signature classes have size >1?
What are primal minimum/maximum degree, edge count, density, k-core degeneracy, triangle count, and low-order cut census through size 4?
